title: Late-Fee Collection Share in a Patient Payment Plan Catch-Up
content:
**Credit and Collections table — late fees in the catch-up of a past-due Patient Payment Plan**

Late fees of the current delinquency join the catch-up at a late-fee collection share: where exactly one installment was recorded as missed within the last 12 months and at least 6 installments were collected by automatic payment within that period, the share is 0.5; where exactly one installment was recorded as missed within that period and fewer than 6 were collected, the share is 0.75; for every other plan the share is one. The late fees of the current delinquency are multiplied by this share as they join the catch-up.

**Counting.** An entry lies within the last 12 months when the whole calendar months between its date and the handling date number fewer than 12. A missed installment is placed by its due date; a collection by automatic payment is placed by the day it was received.

## Table

| Installments recorded as missed within the last 12 months | Installments collected by automatic payment within the last 12 months | Late-fee collection share |
|---|---|---|
| Exactly 1 | 6 or more | 0.5 |
| Exactly 1 | 0 to 5 | 0.75 |
| 0, or 2 or more | Any number | 1 |

## Hypothetical readings

- A plan with a single missed installment in the last 12 months and 8 automatic collections in that period: late fees of 10.00 join the catch-up as 5.00.
- The same plan with 5 automatic collections: the 10.00 joins as 7.50.
- A plan with 2 missed installments in the last 12 months: the share is one and the 10.00 joins in full, whatever the number of collections.
